snippet.title: Ex Nihilo - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
*Will you stay close to safety and see where the journey leads, or will you venture further to find answers and risk it all?*

Ex Nihilo is a non-linear, narrative driven adventure where time is of the essence.

Transported by a strange white light, you find yourself in an otherworldly environment seemingly devoid of human activity, locked in a pod.

When you manage to free yourself, you must explore your surroundings to find a way to escape. But think carefully how far you stray from the security of your pod - after a set amount of time, strange beings start to roam the halls.

*And they have their eye on you.*

Close your eyes to avoid detection, and squint to squeeze past them to safety. Be careful: when you are caught by your pursuers, you will be pruned without mercy, only to reawaken in your pod further from home and with less time to escape.
